chunks: From him, from al-‘Abbās, from Ḥammād, from Ḥarīz, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
A man should not look at the private part of his brother.

key_terms.أَخِيهِ: his brother; here meaning a fellow man
key_terms.عَوْرَةِ: the private part that must be concealed

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a man to look at another man’s private parts in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith forbids a man from looking at the private part of another man. It indicates the obligation of preserving modesty and respecting bodily privacy in social conduct.
